title: Empty state + suggestion chips
desc: A fresh thread shows what to do: clickable suggestion chips for the rehearsed prompts, so nobody stares at an empty box. Chips refill with the next expected prompt after each turn.

title: Copy actions
desc: Copy any message to the clipboard, and every fenced code block gets its own copy button. Actions appear on hover without shifting layout, with copied confirmation in place.

title: Interrupt and redirect
desc: Typing while the agent streams arms the composer: Enter interrupts the turn and sends your new message immediately; a modifier queues it for after the turn instead. Stopping to say something new is one motion, not two.

title: Edit and resend (fork)
desc: Edit any of your messages and resend: the conversation forks at that point and a version pager on the message switches between branches. Nothing is destroyed.

title: Regenerate + feedback
desc: Re-run the last assistant turn as a new version behind the same pager, with thumbs up or down recorded per version.

title: Reasoning disclosure
desc: Extended thinking streams into a collapsible reasoning drawer above the answer, open while thinking, tucked when the answer starts. Needs mock v3.

title: Focus discipline
desc: Focus returns to the input box after actions, and the transcript is fully keyboard-navigable.

title: Parallel tools
desc: Several tools running at once render as separate rows, each with its own state. Needs a parallel-tool mock script.

title: Oversized results
desc: Large tool output shows a short summary inline. The full content loads on demand via content_full_ref.

title: Cost receipt
desc: The done event's result payload (cost, turns, latency) renders as a quiet receipt line under the turn — the contract field nothing displays today.

title: Redacted tool args
desc: Tool inputs carrying secrets render redacted with reveal-on-hold — credentials never sit ambient in a transcript.

title: Task tree
desc: Sub-agents and nested work render as a collapsible tree.

title: Artifact pane
desc: Generated documents open in a side pane next to the chat.

title: Selection-scoped edit
desc: Select part of an artifact and request a change scoped to that selection.

title: Mobile ergonomics
desc: Keyboard avoidance, safe areas, and touch target sizes for phones.

title: Long-transcript performance
desc: The transcript stays smooth with thousands of messages, via virtualization.
